title: QAJobContract
description: Unattended QA job contract for Astra Pro FIRST_72H evidence collection

candidate_id.description: Identifier for the candidate artifact or build being evaluated (e.g. c1, c2, c3, full, or release tag)

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific QA run instance

sha.description: Git commit SHA of the tree being verified

allowed_commands.description: Whitelist of allowed test runner commands or card ids that may be executed

evidence_dir.description: Directory path (relative or absolute) where raw outputs, preflight JSON, junit XML, and jsonl records are published

cards.description: Optional list of card identifiers to execute (e.g. ['c1', 'c2', 'c3'])

requested_model.description: Model ID used by the orchestrator/agent runner (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash)

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata associated with the run
